第13章 地阶低级功法灵焰淬气功（第1页）
地阶低级功法，灵焰淬气功（地阶低级功法，灵焰淬气功（第22页）毕竟和火元诀配套的斗技，火元剑典，如果有功法的加成的话，效果会更好一些。“你倒是贪心，一个人，只有一个斗之气旋，也就是储存斗气的地方，你若是修炼两种功法，若是属性相同的话倒是还好，若是差异较大的话，两种斗气在你的体内对冲，别说是继续修炼了，你能活着，我都夸你命硬。”药老说着，还竖起了大拇指。闻言，萧炎一阵沉默。主要他比较发愁，云韵到时候若是来看自己，发现刚收的天才徒弟就让一个老头拐跑了，这未免有些太伤她心了。不过他也知道，在魂殿这个潜在威胁的压迫下，他必须要抓住一切机会，利用好一切的资源。只有这样，才能够快速崛起，干掉魂天帝！“好，那就拜托老师传法了！”萧炎很快下定了决心，恭敬行了一礼，沉声说道。“凝神！”闻言，药老的神情也变得严肃了几分，旋即虚幻的手指，点在了萧炎的眉心。下一刻，暗红色光泽一闪而过，被灵魂力量承载着的巨大信息流，进入到了萧炎的脑海中。头脑一阵胀痛，也不知道过了多久，才好起来一些。脑海中，崭新的功法内容，像是本就存在于自己的记忆中一般，清晰可见。“《灵焰淬气功》？”萧炎喃喃低语道。药老见状笑了笑，旋即淡然解释起来：“这灵焰淬气功，乃是我当年主修过一段时间的强力功法，虽然只是地阶低级的功法，但在对修炼速度的增幅上，却是丝毫不逊色于一些地阶中级的功法！修炼这功法，是以特定的方法，将斗气浓缩凝聚，辅以灵魂力量，凝聚出一道能够淬炼天地灵气的灵焰，加快修炼的速度。除此之外，这灵焰凝聚而出之后，用于战斗中，则是能够一定程度上点燃对方的斗气，使其攻势被削弱，功效不俗。而对你这幸运拥有异火的小子来说，这功法便更加契合了，万兽灵火本就带有万兽之魂，因此，你根本不需要凝聚灵焰。只需要以自身魂血为根本，将其炼化进万兽灵火之中，使其彻底与你融为一体，按照功法中的方法去操控，便能够以异火代替灵焰，这样一来，这功法淬炼斗气的效率，恐怕会直逼地阶高级的功法！”“地阶高级？”萧炎眼前一亮！这可真是太爽啦！但是焚诀怎么办呢？不管了，先爽了再说，距离青莲地心火，他至少有五年的时间可以去等，根本不需要现在就着急修炼焚诀的事情，五年的时间，说不得都足够他晋级斗灵了，到时候再转修焚诀，利用培养五年后的万兽灵火进阶功法，再吞噬青莲地心火，岂不是刚刚好？想到这里，萧炎心头一定。“那我即刻便开始转修功法！”萧炎兴奋地说道。“诶诶诶，想什么呢？你刚被我吸走斗气，境界都有些不稳定，若是这般随意的改修功法，说不好境界都要再跌落一些，还是先稳固好根基，再转修也不迟！”药老被这个莽夫徒弟的举动搞得心头一颤，连忙制止了他的作死行为。“哦哦，那还是先回去吧。”闻言，萧炎也是冷静了下来，决定听从药老的指点，慢慢来，循序渐进。

Chapter 13 Earth-level low-level skills Spirit Flame Tempering Qigong (page 1)
After all, the Earth-level low-level skill, Spiritual Flame Quenching Qigong (Earth-level low-level skill, Spiritual Flame Quenching Qigong (page 22)) is matched with the fighting skill of Huoyuan Jue, Huoyuan Sword Code. If there is a bonus of the skill, the effect will be better. " You are greedy. A person only has one Dou Zhi Cyclone, which is the place where Dou Qi is stored. If you practice two techniques, it would be fine if the attributes are the same. If the difference is large, the two Dou Qi will be in your Hedging in the body, let alone continuing to practice, I praise you for being alive." Yao Lao said and gave a thumbs up. Xiao Yan was silent for a while. Mainly, he was worried. If Yun Yun came to see him then and found that the talented disciple he had just accepted had been kidnapped by an old man, it would be too sad for her. But he also knew that under the pressure of the potential threat of the Soul Palace, he must seize every opportunity and make good use of it. All resources. Only in this way can we quickly rise and kill the Soul Emperor! "Okay, let the teacher teach you!" Xiao Yan quickly made up his mind, bowed respectfully, and said in a deep voice. "Concentrate!" Hearing this, Yao Lao's expression became a little more serious, and then his illusory finger touched Xiao Yan's eyebrows. The next moment, a dark red light flashed past, and a huge flow of information carried by the soul power entered Xiao Yan's brain. In the sea. I don’t know how long it took for me to feel better. In my mind, the content of the new technique was as clear as if it existed in my memory. ""Spiritual Flame Tempering Qigong"?" Xiao Yan murmured. Seeing this, Yao Lao smiled and explained calmly: "This Spiritual Flame Tempering Qigong is a powerful technique that I practiced for a period of time. Although it is only a low-level technique, In terms of speed increase, it is not inferior to some intermediate-level techniques! The practice of this technique uses a specific method to condense the fighting spirit, supplemented by soul power, to condense a spiritual flame that can temper the spiritual energy of the world, and speed up the practice. In addition, after the spirit flame is condensed, it can ignite the opponent's fighting spirit to a certain extent, weakening the offensive, and it is very effective for you. For those who possess strange fire, this technique is more suitable. The beast spirit fire already contains the soul of the beasts, so you don't need to condense the spirit flame at all. You only need to use your own soul blood as the basis to refine it into the beast spirit fire, so that it can be completely integrated with you. If you control it according to the method, you can replace the spirit flame with the strange fire. In this way, the efficiency of this technique in tempering fighting spirit will probably be comparable to that of advanced earth-level techniques! "Advanced level?" Xiao Yan's eyes lit up! This is so exciting! But what about the Burning Jue? No matter, let's get over it first. He has at least five years to wait before Qinglian's Earthly Heart Fire. There is no need to rush to practice the Burning Jue now. Five years may be enough for him to advance to Douling. When the time comes, he can switch to the Burning Jue and use the advanced skills of Ten Thousand Beasts Spirit Fire after cultivating for five years to devour Qinglian's Earthly Heart Fire. Wouldn't it be just a matter of time? Just in time? Thinking of this, Xiao Yan felt certain. "Then I will start practicing the technique immediately!" Xiao Yan said excitedly, "Hey, what are you thinking about? You have just been sucked away by me, and your state is a little unstable. If you change your skills casually, you may have to fall a little further, so it’s not too late to solidify your foundation first and then switch to another practice!” Yao Lao was shocked by this reckless disciple’s behavior and quickly stopped his act of seeking death.. "Oh, let's go back first." After hearing this, Xiao Yan calmed down and decided to follow Yao Lao's instructions and take his time and proceed step by step.
